ar: صَلَاةً تَدُوْمُ بِدَوَامِكَ وَتَبْقَى بِبَقَائِكَ ، لَامُنْتَهَى لَهَا دُوْنَ عِلْمِكَ ، صَلَاةً تُرْضِيْكَ وَتُرْضِيْهِ ، وَتَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا يَا رَبَّ الْعَلَمِيْنَ .
tr: Ṣalātan tadūmu bi dawāmika wa tabqā bi baqā’ika, Lā muntahā lahā dūna `ilmika, Ṣalātan turḍīka wa turḍīhi, Wa tarḍā bi hā `an nā Yā Rabba ‘l-`Ālamīn.
en: a prayer enduring as long as You and remaining as long as You limited only by Your knowledge, a prayer pleasing You and pleasing him and by which You are pleased with us, O Lord of the Worlds!
